names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 14 octombrie, «Sfântul Silvan, Episcopul Gazei».
Read out of saint.gr's line for 14 Οκτωβρίου, «Όσιος Σιλβανός ο Γέρων Ιερομάρτυρας», with the rank word left off.
The heading of days.pravoslavie.ru's name page 1991, «Сильван Газский, пресвитер, сщмч.», with the office and the rank word left off. The day line gives «Сильвана, пресвитера Газского».

Read out of the Охридски пролог's heading for 4. мај ст. ст., „Свештеномученик Силуан, епископ гаски.“ Свештеномученик is the hieromartyr rank and „епископ гаски“ the second rank and the see, which this corpus puts in `types` and in `office`; strip them and the bare forename is left. **The spelling is this book's own, Силуан and not Силван**, and is stored exactly as printed — a copied script form is never corrected by a reader, and the Russian form on this folder is Сильван Газский. The form meets no other folder in any language in either spelling, which was measured rather than assumed.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 14 октября ст. ст. — «Сщмч. Сильвана, пресвитера Газского (IV).»
source.note: No rank is read onto this line. The day prints two icons and both stand in its first paragraph: the plain service, «Cовершается служба, не отмеченная в Типиконе никаким знаком» — a service the Typikon marks with no sign at all, before the four martyrs of Milan, and «Совершается служба со славословием» immediately before Paraskeva-Petka, which is that one great line's alone. Neither reaches a later line.

attestations.note: The Russian gives this folder its first date, the fourth century, and the three things no other calendar prints for him: that he was of Gaza and was its presbyter, that he was sent to forced labour in the mines of the Palestinian town of Phaeno for his zeal in spreading the faith, and that he was beheaded in the end together with forty Christian soldiers. The calendar calls him «сщмч.», a hieromartyr, and «пресвитер», which is the priesthood and not the bishopric this folder's types carry from the Greek.

source.text: doxologia.ro, calendarul zilei pentru 14 octombrie — «Sfântul Silvan, Episcopul Gazei»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 14ης Οκτωβρίου — «Όσιος Σιλβανός ο Γέρων Ιερομάρτυρας»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 14 Οκτωβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same menologion day the folder already keeps for the Romanian church, and the entry is the same man: of Gaza in Palestine, gentle and harmless and old, a soldier before, made a presbyter for the purity of his life, beaten by the crowd at Caesarea, sent to the mines at Zoora and beheaded in old age and sickness. **A difference worth naming, and not a contradiction of the row**: the folder carries `types: ["martyr", "bishop"]` on doxologia's word that he was counted worthy to be made a bishop after the faithful got him away from the mines, and this page gives him no bishopric — it says «έγινε Πρεσβύτερος στην Εκκλησία της Γάζας», and at the mines «με παρότρηση του λαού, γίνεται επίτροπος», a steward. It adds that he had been a soldier. Nothing is changed on the strength of it; the paragraph says what this page says. The page gives no year, only «επί Διοκλητιανού (284 - 304 μ.Χ.)», so no `dates` object, and it prints no hymn. Its last sentence is the ground of the new folder `forty-martyrs-of-egypt-and-palestine` in batch `el-10-14`. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence on the life page.

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 17.05.2026 (4. мај ст. ст.) — „Свештеномученик Силуан, епископ гаски.“

attestations.note: **`sr-cand.mjs`'s day list could not see this folder, because the three calendars that had read him all keep him on 14 October and the Prologue keeps him on 4. мај ст. ст.** `ls saints | grep -iE 'silvan|silouan|siluan'` found him at once, which is the fourth day in five on which that command has caught what the day list could not. **Two days and four churches, and that is not a conflict**: the Russian, Romanian and Greek rows stay on 14 October and none of them was moved. The identification is Gaza, the rank and the martyrdom: „Свештеномученик Силуан, епископ гаски“ against doxologia's «Sfântul Silvan, Episcopul Gazei» and saint.gr's «Όσιος Σιλβανός ο Γέρων Ιερομάρτυρας», all three a hieromartyr of Gaza, which this folder already holds as `martyr` and `bishop`. **This book is a second source for the episcopate**, against the Sretensky line's «пресвитера Газского». **A year was read and deliberately NOT written, and this is the sharpest open date of my five days.** „посечен са четрдесет других војника 311. године“ gives **311**, where this folder's `death` is `301–400`, „4th century“, taken from the Sretensky line's «(IV)». 311 falls **inside** that century, so there is no disagreement at all — and replacing the century with the year would still be **narrowing a sourced interval**, which the coordinator's ruling forbids without qualification. The tension is real and is the author's: `date-audit.mjs` exists to find a finding weaker than its sources allow, and after this reading this folder is one. **Nothing was touched**, and one commit takes the year if the author wants it. New besides: that he was **first in military service** and crossed to the spiritual service driven by the force of his own faith; that the charge was **converting pagans to Christians**; and that he was **bitterly tortured first and then beheaded with forty other soldiers**, „и тако сви посташе грађани небески“. **The forty take no folder**: the entry names not one of them, so by the coordinator's ruling the company that enumerates nobody is one entry, and it is said here. The Prologue prints no troparion and no kontakion.

death.note: The century days.pravoslavie.ru prints after his name, «Сщмч. Сильвана, пресвитера Газского (IV)», and repeats in its life. Neither doxologia.ro nor saint.gr gives a date, and this folder held none.
